title: What can go wrong
subtitle: Six ways a hand-over fails: a link in a public channel, expired, the wrong key, a vault key in a link, and what revocation does and does not do. 9 panels.
rule: Every line a character says is the storyboard's, not a quote, and is marked not_a_quote; evidence panels quote this site's pages word for word, which the build checks.

scenes.title: What can go wrong
scenes.subtitle: Expiry, caps and revocation limit the future. Nothing takes back the past.
scenes.note: The failures, each with what it costs and what the site does about it.

scenes.caption: The link in a public channel

cast.says: A link is as private as where it went.

lines: = everyone in the chat has the file
send the key by another channel

scenes.note: The link-only option exists for exactly this: the id by one channel, the key by another.

scenes.caption: Expired, or spent

cast.says: Seven days. I'll send a new one.

scenes.note: 410 is an end state, not an error to retry: expired or exhausted.

scenes.caption: Wrong key

cast.says: It says the key does not open it.

scenes.note: A wrong key fails cleanly; the bytes were never readable, so nothing is half-opened.

scenes.caption: A vault key in a link

cast.says: That was write access. New vault, copy the files, new read key.

scenes.note: The open page opens it, with a warning: a vault key should never have travelled in a link.

scenes.caption: Revoke, from Keys

cast.says: Deleted on the server. The link opens nothing now.

scenes.note: A transfer sent from this device keeps its delete secret; revoking deletes it on the server.

scenes.caption: What revocation does not do

lines: a read key, once out, is out
a copy fetched is a copy kept

scenes.note: Rotating protects the future; nothing on the server reaches a copy already fetched.

scenes.caption: Not retroactive

evidence.quote: revocation is not retroactive, because anyone who fetched the objects keeps them.

scenes.note: Quoted from the vaults and keys page, word for word.

scenes.punchline: Expiry, caps and revocation limit the future. Nothing takes back the past.
scenes.note: The security page ends with what the site does not claim.
